# Yadav Motors - Werribee's Trusted Local Mechanic

> Yadav Motors (T/A Russell Street Automotive) is a professional automotive workshop located in Werribee, Victoria, specializing in comprehensive care for all vehicle makes and models, including modern EVs and hybrids.

## Contact Information
- **Phone:** 0430 869 699
- **Email:** info@yadavmotors.com.au
- **Address:** 11/67-71 Russell St, Werribee VIC 3030
- **Website:** [www.yadavmotors.com.au](https://www.yadavmotors.com.au)
- **Maps:** [Google Maps Location](https://maps.google.com/?q=11/67-71+Russell+St,+Werribee+VIC+3030)

## Professional Accreditations
- **VACC Member:** Victorian Automotive Chamber of Commerce.
- **AASRA Member:** Australian Automotive Service and Repair Authority.
- **ARC Licensed (AU54941):** Certified for vehicle air conditioning service and repairs.
- **TAT Member:** The Automotive Technician network.
- **Capricorn Member:** Preferred supplier network.
- **Fully Insured:** All work is covered for peace of mind.

## Core Services
- **Log Book Servicing:** Manufacturer-compliant servicing to maintain new car warranties.
- **Servicing EV & Hybrid:** Specialized maintenance for electric and hybrid vehicles, including Tesla.
- **Brakes & Clutch:** Full inspections, pad replacements, and clutch repairs.
- **Air Conditioning:** Licensed (ARC) A/C servicing and re-gassing.
- **Tyres & Wheel Alignment:** New tyres, balancing, and precision alignment.
- **Engine & Diagnostics:** Advanced scan-tool diagnostics and mechanical repairs.
- **Windscreen & ADAS Calibration:** Expert windscreen replacement and precise camera calibration for safety systems.
- **Transmission Service:** Automatic and manual transmission fluid changes and repairs.
- **Auto Electrical:** Battery testing, fault diagnosis, and electrical repairs.
- **Free Pick-Up & Drop-Off:** Available within 10km of the Werribee workshop.

## Trust Signals

- **Customers Served:** 3,261+ satisfied customers.

## Service Areas
Werribee, Hoppers Crossing, Tarneit, Point Cook, Wyndham Vale, Truganina, Laverton, Mambourin, Manor Lakes, and Little River.
